paragraphs.text: Planet is a nonbasic land type used for cards that depict celestial body moving in an elliptical orbit round a star. It was introduced in Edge of Eternities .
Planet doesn't have any rules or functionality tied to it , but the non-token Planets released so far all have Station . Planets enter tapped and can be used to produce mana of the appropriate type.

The station cost (N+) is visible in a circle lower left of the text box of the card frame . Once a set threshold of charge counters is placed on them, Planets gain an additional ability. Unlike most Spacecraft , they don't become creatures .

Susur Secundi, Void Altar Land — Planet This land enters tapped. : Add . Station (Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters equal to its power on this Planet. Station only as a sorcery.) 12+ | , , Pay 2 life, Sacrifice a creature: Draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature’s power. Activate only as a sorcery.
The Doctor Who set featured various planets in its setting as planar types including Apalapucia , Darillium , Earth , Gallifrey , Mars , New Earth , Time , Trenzalore , and Unknown Planet .
Star Trek features planethopping in its lore; it also includes a creature that can creature Planet land tokens.
